an10.218:1.1: Nāhaṃ bhikkhave sañcetanikānaṃ kammānaṃ katānaṃ upacitānaṃ appaṭisaṃviditvā vyantibhāvaṃ vadāmi,
an10.218:1.2: tañ ca kho diṭṭh' eva dhamme upapajjaṃ vā apare vā pariyāye.
an10.218:1.3: Na tvevāhaṃ bhikkhave sañcetanikānaṃ kammānaṃ katānaṃ upacitanaṃ appaṭisaṃviditvā dukkhass' antakiriyaṃ vadāmi.
an10.218:2.1: Tatra bhikkhave tividhā kāyakammantasandosavyāpatti akusalasañcetanikā dukkhudrayā dukkhavipākā hoti,
an10.218:2.2: catubbidhā vacīkammantasandosavyāpatti akusalasañcetanikā dukkhudrayā dukkhavipākā hoti,
an10.218:2.3: tividhā manokammantasandosavyāpatti akusalasañcetanikā dukkhudrayā dukkhavipākā hoti.
an10.218:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave tividhā kāyakammantasandosavyāpatti akusalasañcetanikā dukkhudrayā dukkhavipākā hoti? . . . pe . . .
an10.218:3.2: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave tividhā kāyakammantasandosavyāpatti akusalasañcetanikā dukkhudrayā dukkhavipākā hoti.

an10.218:4.2: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave catubbidhā vacīkammantasandosavyāpatti akusalasañcetanikā dukkhudrayā dukkhavipākā hoti.

an10.218:5.2: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave tividhā manokammantasandosavyāpatti akusalasañcetanikā dukkhudrayā dukkhavipākā hoti. 2.
an10.218:6.1: Tividhakāyakammantasandosavyāpatti-akusalasañcetanikāhetu vā bhikkhave sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti, catubbidhavacīkammanta- . . .pe . . . tividhamanokammantasan dosavyāpatti-akusalasañcetanikāhetu vā bhikkhave sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti. 3.
